title: A Bush That Would Not Burn Up
paragraphs: Moses was minding sheep in the desert, a long way from the palace he grew up in. Then he saw something odd: a bush on fire that wasn't burning away. He went closer, and a voice said, "Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground." God said that he had seen how his people suffered in Egypt, had heard their cry, and was sending Moses. Moses made excuses, asking who he was to go to Pharaoh. God said, "Certainly I will be with you." That was the whole answer. God does not stay up in the sky; God hears, comes close, and sends people to help.
wonder: I wonder why God chose a plain bush and a shepherd?
activity: Take off your shoes for a minute and stand still in the grass or on the carpet, noticing the ground.
prayer: God who hears our cries, make us listeners too, and show us how to help. Amen.
alt: A green bush glows with golden flames that do not burn it, with a pair of sandals in the foreground.
hidden: A tiny sandal-print in the sand.
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
